errors.evidence: The third bar from the left is not the highest; its height is approximately 0.175. The description wrongly assigns the properties of the fourth bar (highest, frequency ~0.47) to the third bar and misplaces it on the x-axis ('около 6').

errors.text_span: а четвъртият, около 7, е с честота около 0.17
errors.evidence: The fourth bar is the tallest (frequency ~0.47). The description incorrectly states its frequency is ~0.17 and places it 'около 7'. The frequency of ~0.17 actually corresponds to the third and fifth bars.
